lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: I've been carrying this rock for 3 hours. I don't know where to put it.

lines.speaker: bystander
lines.text: Have you tried... setting it down?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: I am one with the rock now. Do not interrupt our journey.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Just watched a guy harvest an entire field by walking diagonally through it.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: We don't talk about the diagonal walk.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: I tried it once. They found my body in a fence.

lines.speaker: smith
lines.text: These timber beams are solid, but my chisels are dull.

lines.speaker: carpenter
lines.text: Bring them to the grindstone after the shift.

lines.speaker: smith
lines.text: A sharp tool makes the sun go down faster.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: My fingers are numb through these gloves.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Short daylight today. Keep moving to stay warm.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: One more cartload before the frost sets in.

lines.speaker: carpenter
lines.text: Roof is leaking right over the dry storage.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Move the grain sacks to the barn first!

lines.speaker: carpenter
lines.text: I'll climb up with fresh thatch once the wind dies.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Are we getting a half day before the festival revels?

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Only if the storage bins are stacked and swept.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Consider it done. Nobody delays the tavern kegs.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: Perimeter is quiet, but the woods feel too still.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Keep torches lit along the palisade line.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: Eyes open until relief arrives at dawn.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: I saw two glowing eyes past the tree line.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Wolf pack or just a very confident raccoon?

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: Either way, it didn't look like it pays village taxes.

lines.speaker: hunter
lines.text: Fresh deer tracks cutting south toward the creek.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Wind is blowing right into their clearing.

lines.speaker: hunter
lines.text: Circle downwind. Easy does it.

lines.speaker: hunter
lines.text: There — a massive stag in the clearing!

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Draw slowly... don't snap the dry twigs.

lines.speaker: hunter
lines.text: Clean shot. The village eats well tonight.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: The clock tower struck thirteen. I think it is asking for overtime.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: It has been asking for overtime since I started talking to it.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: You talk to the clock?

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: Only on nights when it lies about the hour.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Then we agree the machinery is malfunctioning.

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: No. We agree it knows exactly what it is doing.

lines.speaker: carpenter
lines.text: I repaired this fence twice today.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Was it broken twice?

lines.speaker: carpenter
lines.text: No. It moved while I was looking for my hammer.
